# hetznerrobot_boot (Data Source)

Reads the boot options of a dedicated server — the Rescue Systems, distributions, Windows versions and languages its boot configurations accept, and which configuration is pending. While a configuration is active, Robot reports only its chosen value instead of the full list. Passwords are never exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_boot" "web" {
  server_number = 321
}

output "installable_linux" {
  value = data.hetznerrobot_boot.web.linux_dists
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_number` (Number) Server to read.

### Read-Only

- `linux_active` (Boolean) Whether a Linux installation is pending.
- `linux_dists` (List of String) Distributions of the Linux installation.
- `linux_langs` (List of String) Languages of the Linux installation.
- `rescue_active` (Boolean) Whether the Rescue System is pending.
- `rescue_os` (List of String) Rescue Systems (`os` of `hetznerrobot_boot_rescue`).
- `vnc_active` (Boolean) Whether a VNC installation is pending.
- `vnc_dists` (List of String) Distributions of the VNC installation.
- `vnc_langs` (List of String) Languages of the VNC installation.
- `windows_active` (Boolean) Whether a Windows installation is pending.
- `windows_langs` (List of String) Languages of the Windows installation.
- `windows_os` (List of String) Windows versions (needs the Windows addon; empty when it is not available).
